source: Curated from Reuters, Bloomberg, EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Reports, and trade press
note: Historical anchors for the Brent chart event overlay and the map outage layer. Volumes and price-reaction figures are ballpark from contemporaneous reporting, not forensic reconstructions. Curator refreshes this file as new events occur.

events.name: Stena Impero Tanker Seizure
events.summary: IRGC seized the UK-flagged tanker Stena Impero in the Strait of Hormuz. No physical volume loss but the incident catalysed insurance spikes and a Brent move.

events.name: Fujairah UAE Tanker Attacks
events.summary: Four tankers off Fujairah damaged by limpet mines. Attribution disputed; Gulf of Oman insurance spiked, Brent up on session.

events.name: Gulf of Oman Tanker Attacks
events.summary: Front Altair and Kokuka Courageous hit by explosive devices in Gulf of Oman. US attributed to Iran. Brent jumped ~4% intraday before fading.

events.name: Abqaiq-Khurais Strike
events.summary: Drone and cruise-missile strike on Abqaiq processing facility and Khurais field. Removed ~5.7 mbpd capacity — the largest single-day supply disruption in Gulf history. Brent gapped ~15% on the reopen.

events.name: Iran al-Asad Missile Strike
events.summary: Iranian ballistic-missile strike on US al-Asad airbase following the Soleimani killing. Brent spiked then retraced once damage proved contained.

events.name: Beirut Port Explosion
events.summary: Ammonium nitrate explosion destroyed Beirut's main port and grain silos. No crude impact but repriced regional risk premium for days.

events.name: Houthi Ras Tanura Drone Attack
events.summary: Houthi drone and missile barrage at the Ras Tanura oil terminal and Aramco facilities in Dhahran. Intercepted, minimal physical damage, but Brent rallied ~3% on the headline.

events.name: MT Mercer Street Drone Strike
events.summary: Drone strike on Israeli-linked Mercer Street tanker off Oman killed two crew. Attributed to Iran. Freight rates spiked for Gulf routes.

events.name: Houthi Abu Dhabi Mussafah Strike
events.summary: Houthi cruise missile and drone strike on ADNOC fuel storage at Mussafah, Abu Dhabi. Three killed; Brent up on first direct Houthi attack on UAE oil infrastructure.

events.name: Russia Full-Scale Invasion of Ukraine
events.summary: Russian invasion of Ukraine triggered the largest sanctions regime against a major crude exporter in modern history. Brent climbed above $130 within days; structural repricing of Gulf benchmarks followed.

events.name: Jeddah Aramco Storage Strike
events.summary: Houthi missile hit Saudi Aramco bulk storage in Jeddah during the Formula 1 Grand Prix. Visible smoke plume, 120 kbpd effectively idled during cleanup.

events.name: Nord Stream Pipeline Sabotage
events.summary: Underwater explosions destroyed three of the four Nord Stream gas pipelines in the Baltic. Gas not crude, but global energy risk premium rose for weeks.

events.name: Galaxy Leader Red Sea Seizure
events.summary: Houthi forces seized the Galaxy Leader in the southern Red Sea, opening the sustained 2023-24 campaign against Red Sea shipping. Tanker diversions around the Cape of Good Hope began in earnest.

events.name: Marlin Luanda Tanker Strike
events.summary: Houthi anti-ship missile hit the Trafigura-chartered Marlin Luanda in the Gulf of Aden, carrying Russian naphtha. First confirmed tanker fire in the Houthi campaign.

events.name: Iran Direct Strike on Israel
events.summary: Iran launched ~300 drones and missiles directly at Israel from its own territory. First direct state-on-state strike between the two; Hormuz closure risk premium re-priced overnight.

events.name: Israel Strike on Iranian Military Sites
events.summary: Israel struck Iranian air-defense and missile-production sites. Crucially spared oil infrastructure — Brent fell on relief despite the escalation.

events.name: Iran Gas Station Cyberattack
events.summary: Coordinated cyberattack knocked out ~70% of Iranian gas stations. Downstream only; Brent barely reacted but flagged here because a state-level cyber envelope on oil infra is an increasingly relevant category.

events.name: Basra Oil Pipeline Fire
events.summary: Pipeline fire at Basra Oil Company infrastructure in southern Iraq. Briefly diverted export flow; minimal Brent reaction.

events.name: OPEC+ Surprise Production Cut Announcement
events.summary: OPEC+ announced a surprise 1.16 mbpd voluntary cut outside its formal meeting schedule. Not an outage in the physical sense, but a deliberate supply withdrawal that moved Brent ~$5 on reopen. Categorised as 'sanctions' here loosely (policy-driven volume constraint).

events.name: Hezbollah Leadership Strike
events.summary: Israeli strike on Hezbollah leadership in Beirut. Middle East escalation premium reset higher; Brent moved on the headline before the curve settled.
